page.overview:
Who is Harvey Rodcap?

Harvey is the next-generation Easy Idle racer and one of the six next-generation racers to debut at the Motor Speedway of the South.

During Los Angeles 500 at the Los Angeles International Speedway, he and Tim Treadless were close behind Lightning McQueen when he crashed and went airborne. Both watched in horror as McQueen went flying. In 2017, Harvey competed in the Florida 500 at the Florida International Super Speedway where he started from 16th position. After Cam Spinner caused a crash, Harvey smashed into Cam and was sent careening toward the infield and received minor damages, though was able to continue racing.

Harvey has brown eyes and a blue, white, and dark gray livery, with an Easy Idle logo, and a racing number 15.
